map.输入纸张缺陷类型和参数，按GB/T 451.2等标准判定纸张质量等级: Enter the paper defect type and parameters, and grade the paper quality against standards such as GB/T 451.2
map.📖 查看「纸病（孔洞/刮痕）检测 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Paper Defect (Holes/Scratches) Detection'
Paper defect grading (GB/T 451.2 etc.): graded by hole diameter and count - for printing paper, a hole diameter greater than 2.0 mm or a defect count per square metre over the limit is reject; defect area ratio = Σ defect area ÷ inspected area × 100%; the grade (qualified, downgraded or reject) is decided by paper type and defect type.
map.外观质检中，按纸种与缺陷类型对照允收限（尺寸、密度）判定等级。: In appearance inspection, the grade is decided by comparing the acceptance limits (size, density) against the paper type and defect type.
map.印刷用纸对孔洞/斑点敏感，包装用纸对刮痕/气泡容忍度不同，限值各异。: Printing paper is sensitive to holes/specks, while packaging paper has a different tolerance for scratches/blisters, so the limits differ.
map.整批放行前，统计单位面积缺陷数，结合单缺陷尺寸综合评级。: Before releasing a batch, count the defects per unit area and combine them with the single-defect size for an overall grade.
map.算例：印刷纸孔洞判定（尺寸 2.5mm，密度 8 个/m²，面积 10m²）: Worked example: hole grading for printing paper (size 2.5mm, density 8 per m², area 10m²)
map.印刷纸孔洞允收限：尺寸≤2mm、密度≤5 个/m²。实测尺寸 2.5mm>2（超: Acceptance limits for printing paper holes: size≤2mm, density≤5 per m². Measured size 2.5mm>2 (oversize) and density 8>5 (over density) → reject; this 10 m² area has about 8×10=80 defects in total. Formula: total defects = density × area. [SRC]
map.尺寸与密度均不超限且均在半数以内→优等品；均不超限→一等品；仅一项不超限→合格品: Both size and density within limits and both within half the limit → superior grade; both within limits → first grade; only one within limits → qualified; both over limits → reject. Look up the limit table for the paper type.
map.不同纸种的缺陷限值一样吗？: Are the defect limits the same for different paper types?
map.不一样。本工具内置印刷/包装/生活/工业四类限值：如孔洞，印刷纸尺寸≤2mm、密: No. This tool has built-in limits for four categories: printing/packaging/tissue/industrial paper. For holes, printing paper is size≤2mm and density≤5, while industrial paper is relaxed to size≤10mm and density≤10. Choosing the wrong paper type gives a wrong verdict.
map.尺寸和密度哪个更关键？: Which matters more, size or density?
map.都关键，但大尺寸缺陷（孔洞、气泡）对印刷断纸/外观影响更致命，通常优先卡尺寸；密: Both matter, but large-size defects (holes, blisters) are more damaging to print break-through and appearance, so size is usually checked first; density reflects overall cleanliness. Exceeding either limit at the same time means reject.
map.纸病检测依据GB/T 451.2《纸和纸板定量的测定》及GB/T 15442相关: Paper defect detection is based on GB/T 451.2 'Determination of grammage of paper and board' and related GB/T 15442 standards
map.印刷用纸要求最严格，孔洞≤2mm且≤5个/m²；包装用纸可适当放宽: Printing paper has the strictest requirements: holes≤2mm and ≤5 per m²; packaging paper may be moderately relaxed
map.孔洞和裂口影响印刷和包装性能，严重时导致断纸或印刷漏印: Holes and tears affect printing and packaging performance, and in severe cases cause break-through or missing print
map.检测应在标准光源下进行，检测面积不少于5m²以保证统计可靠性: Detection should be carried out under standard light sources, over an area of at least 5m² to ensure statistical reliability
map.常见原因：网部成型不良、压榨部压力不均、烘缸表面污染等: Common causes: poor formation on the wire, uneven press pressure, contamination of the dryer drum surface, etc.
